corrections_to_v1.v1_claim: 19 admitted fan-out records had their branch structure normalized away
corrections_to_v1.correction: WRONG mechanism. All 19 records' edges are fully preserved in their candidates (verified edge-by-edge). The loss is classification masking: graph_profile classifies merge before branch, so fan-in+fan-out hybrids are labeled multi_input_merge and their fan-out is invisible in the label. The 19 records collapse into 7 distinct hybrid DAGs. Nothing needs normalization repair; the taxonomy needs the four-way reading.

corrections_to_v1.v1_claim: of the 57 pending fan-out records, 32 survive rule C (~20 distinct branch structures)
corrections_to_v1.correction: WRONG. That estimate applied roster analysis only. Running the REAL nine-index Gate 2 (fingerprint_record + build_overlap_indexes + check_candidate_overlap over the frozen 104.7MB exclusion ledger) plus the pool builder's strict gate1 and graph_profile: 63 pending records -> 35 rejected invalid graph (disconnected/out-of-range/cyclic) + 28 rejected gate2 overlap (real exclusion-index hits, dominated by normalized_dag_key / forbidden_near_dag_key / semantic_dag_key at 19 hits each) + 0 eligible.
